question: Should experimental schemaVersion 1 retain its documented descriptive CLAW.md body, with portable prompt materialization introduced behind a new package-contract version or explicit manifest field?
rationale: This determines whether existing opted-in packages may change agent behavior on add or update; implementation tests cannot establish that compatibility policy.

options.title: Version the prompt contract
options.body: Preserve schema-v1 descriptive bodies and introduce the new prompt interpretation through an explicit schema or manifest boundary with upgrade coverage.

options.title: Adopt the breaking schema-v1 reinterpretation
options.body: Approve changing all existing experimental schema-v1 bodies into prompts and document the supported migration and conflict behavior before merge.

options.title: Pause for RFC alignment
options.body: Hold this PR until the related portable-package RFC records the adopted compatibility boundary.

recommendation.title: Version the prompt contract
recommendation.body: Preserve schema-v1 descriptive bodies and introduce the new prompt interpretation through an explicit schema or manifest boundary with upgrade coverage.
